name: Derived Data
detail: Build intermediates, indexes and logs. Xcode rebuilds these on the next build.

name: iOS Device Support
detail: Debug symbols copied from connected iPhones and iPads, one folder per OS build.

name: tvOS Device Support
detail: Debug symbols copied from connected Apple TVs, one folder per OS build.

name: watchOS Device Support
detail: Debug symbols copied from paired Apple Watches, one folder per OS build.

name: Documentation Cache
detail: Downloaded and indexed developer documentation. Re-fetched on demand.

name: Products & Device Logs
detail: Exported build products and crash logs pulled from devices.

name: Xcode Downloads
detail: Leftover installers and components downloaded by older Xcode versions.

name: XcodeBuildMCP Data
detail: Build artifacts and logs from the XcodeBuildMCP tooling.

name: Xcode Application Cache
detail: Xcode's own scratch cache, separate from Derived Data.

name: Device Connection Cache
detail: Staged app bundles and symbols CoreDevice keeps when running on real  devices. Rebuilt on the next run.

name: Apple Configurator Downloads
detail: Device firmware and staging files Apple Configurator left in its temporary folder. Downloaded again the next time a device is restored or updated.

name: Archives
detail: Distribution builds and their dSYMs. Without these you cannot symbolicate  crash reports from versions you already shipped.

name: Simulator Caches
detail: Shared CoreSimulator caches, including dyld and image caches. No devices are  removed.

name: Test Simulator Clones
detail: Simulator clones created by parallel testing. Usually stale, and often the  single largest item on this machine.

name: Simulator Devices
detail: Your installed simulators, including any apps and data inside them.

name: Playground Devices
detail: Simulator instances backing Swift Playgrounds previews.

name: Xcode System Resources
detail: Installer packages Xcode downloads per OS build. One folder per build, so old ones pile up after every update; Xcode refetches what it needs.

name: Swift Package Manager
detail: Cloned package repositories and resolved artifacts. Re-fetched on the next  resolve.

name: CocoaPods Cache
detail: Downloaded pod sources. Restored by the next `pod install`.

name: CocoaPods Spec Repos
detail: Podspec repositories, including any private ones — those must be added  again by hand with `pod repo add`.

name: Carthage
detail: Cloned dependencies and prebuilt frameworks.

name: Homebrew
detail: Downloaded bottles and casks. Homebrew refetches whatever it needs.

name: Gradle
detail: Dependency cache, daemon logs and downloaded Gradle distributions.

name: Android SDK
detail: Build and IDE caches. Emulator images in ~/.android/avd are left alone.

name: Android Studio
detail: Android Studio's caches and indexes. Rebuilt when the IDE next opens a project.

name: JetBrains IDEs
detail: Indexes and caches for IntelliJ, WebStorm, PyCharm and the rest. Settings  live elsewhere and are untouched.

name: VS Code
detail: VS Code's cached extension downloads and compiled data. Rebuilt as you open projects and install extensions; the web cache beside it is covered by Desktop App Web Caches.

name: npm & npx Cache
detail: Package tarballs and one-off npx installs. npm re-downloads as needed.

name: Yarn
detail: Package cache. Yarn re-downloads whatever a project needs.

name: pnpm
detail: Content-addressable package store. Restored by pnpm install.

name: Electron
detail: Prebuilt Electron binaries downloaded by app builds.

name: Python pip
detail: Downloaded wheels and source archives.

name: Rust Cargo
detail: Crate registry cache and sources. Installed binaries in ~/.cargo/bin are  left alone.

name: Go Build Cache
detail: Compiled package objects. Rebuilt on the next build.

name: Maven
detail: The local artifact repository, re-downloaded on the next build.

name: NuGet
detail: Global package cache for .NET projects.

name: Dart & Flutter Packages
detail: The pub package cache, restored by `flutter pub get`.

name: Bun
detail: Downloaded packages for bun install. Refetched on the next install.

name: Deno
detail: Fetched remote modules and the compiled-module cache. Deno re-downloads  them when a script next runs.

name: Playwright Browsers
detail: Downloaded Chromium, Firefox and WebKit builds. Large, and refetched by  playwright install.

name: Composer
detail: PHP package and repository cache.

name: Composer (Library)
detail: Composer's cache in its newer location. Same contents, refetched on install.

name: nvm Downloads
detail: Node tarballs kept after install. The installed versions themselves are  left alone.

name: SDKMAN Archives
detail: Downloaded JDK and tool archives. The unpacked versions are left alone.

name: TypeScript
detail: Auto-installed type definitions for editors.

name: Shared Tool Cache
detail: ~/.cache, shared by many CLI tools. Regenerable, but cleaning it can interrupt a CLI session that is running right now.

name: node-gyp Headers
detail: Node headers and libraries kept per version for building native modules. Redownloaded on the next native build.

name: Playwright Browsers (Go)
detail: Browser builds downloaded by the Go port of Playwright, kept separately from the Node one. Refetched on the next install.

name: Rust Toolchains (rustup)
detail: Full compiler and standard library copies for each Rust toolchain rustup installed. Reinstalled with rustup toolchain install, though the download isn't instant.

name: ccache
detail: Cached compiler object files, keyed by source and flags. Rebuilt automatically on the next cache miss.

name: sccache
detail: Mozilla's shared compiler cache for Rust and C/C++ builds. Rebuilt automatically as you compile.

name: Poetry Cache
detail: Downloaded package artifacts and virtual environments Poetry keeps between installs. Refetched and rebuilt on the next poetry install.

name: uv Cache
detail: Downloaded wheels and sources the uv package manager keeps for reuse across projects. Refetched on the next install.

name: Vagrant Boxes
detail: Downloaded base VM images added with vagrant box add. Re-downloaded the next time a Vagrantfile needs one.

name: Ivy Cache (sbt/Scala)
detail: Downloaded JARs and dependencies sbt resolves through Ivy. Refetched on the next build.

name: Expo CLI Cache
detail: Cached simulator builds, native module downloads and templates the Expo CLI keeps between runs. Refetched as needed.

name: Go Modules
detail: Source of every module version your Go builds have downloaded. Re-fetched from the network on the next build that needs one, which is what `go clean -modcache` leaves behind.

name: conda Packages
detail: Package archives conda keeps after installing them into environments. Downloaded again when an environment next needs them; the environments themselves are elsewhere.

name: Miniconda Packages
detail: The package archive cache inside a Miniconda install. Re-downloaded when an environment needs them again.

name: Anaconda Packages
detail: The package archive cache inside an Anaconda install. Re-downloaded when an environment needs them again.

name: Miniforge Packages
detail: The package archive cache inside a Miniforge install. Re-downloaded when an environment needs them again.

name: mise
detail: Tool archives and metadata mise downloads while installing runtimes. Fetched again the next time a version is installed.

name: Tart VM Images
detail: Virtual machine images Tart has pulled from a registry. Pulled again on demand; VMs you created yourself are stored separately.

name: Mambaforge Packages
detail: The package archive cache inside a Mambaforge install. Re-downloaded when an environment needs them again.

name: Lima VM Images
detail: Guest images Lima downloaded to create its virtual machines, kept by URL hash. Fetched again the next time a machine is created; the machines themselves live in ~/.lima and are untouched.

name: Android NDK
detail: Native development kits the Android SDK manager has installed, one folder per version and several gigabytes each. Re-downloaded through the SDK manager; a project pinned to a version needs that version back before it builds.
